subcomponents: Define native C++ original raw rank WVP evidence with physical shader/epoch, original write/draw serial, queue producer/epoch, and pose congruence; keep R30 original source selection unchanged.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Prepared rank stereo eyes only submit when the same original car anchor and raw c64 shader/queue source remain coherent at LEFT and RIGHT boundaries.
Reentrant native or eye state setters changing rank owner, raw WVP writer, queue node/epoch, pose or shader refuse foreign right-eye submission while preserving restoration and original fallback.
The exact final result SHA passes all required GitHub Windows game, OpenXR host, package, domain, inspector and full-source gates; physical Quest3/VDXR remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30GetOwnedRankRawWvp verified original game c64 for Calc3D2D projected car/rival rank at stereo eye preparation, but R33 only stamped queue marker/shader before left and after left without original raw writer or right setter revalidation.
diagnosis.root_cause: R33 native shader projected rank could reuse prepared right-eye projection after original game c64 writer changed, while the physical marker and shader remained the same, or after right pass setters reentered a different car/queue.
source_trace: Exact rank producer retains marker and queue source through existing original game callbacks, distinct from HUD 6th/6 rank.
R30 prepares the original source-owned car WVP only for previously verified raw shader, pose, producer and queue evidence.
R33 now captures original upload generation and producer before native LEFT, after LEFT, and immediately before RIGHT, reverting to native state restoration when identity changes.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: LEFT and RIGHT require the same car anchor and original raw shader-upload generation; static/CI verification cannot prove actual Quest3 binocular visuals.
alternatives_rejected: Do not force vehicle markers into flat ScreenHud or borrow unrelated world c64 for missing original source.
Do not remove the conservative fallback or globally widen producer ownership.
Do not confuse native right GPU draw identity with generic R33 stereo route counters.
